delta.semantics: Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy + Binding fail closed on every io.katacontainers.* Pod annotation for a dedicated ClayVerse runtime namespace; CREATE/UPDATE Pods only; failurePolicy Fail; validationActions Deny. Runtime/containerd configuration remains separately attested.

observed_gap: Current canonical MicroVM contract requires Kubernetes admission to reject unreviewed io.katacontainers.* runtime-mutating annotations, but current main had no repository admission-policy implementation for that contract.
external_primary_evidence: Kubernetes Validating Admission Policy is stable and supports CEL validations, failurePolicy Fail, bindings and validationActions Deny.

Kata Containers documents io.katacontainers.* Pod annotations as per-pod runtime configuration and warns that some annotations can affect host-side/runtime behavior; containerd can pass the annotation namespace to Kata.

Current Kata security advisories include annotation-driven host-path/configuration boundary failures, reinforcing fail-closed admission as defense in depth without replacing runtime configuration attestation.

counterhypothesis: A repository template with no Kata annotations is sufficient because the checked-in StatefulSet is clean.
counterhypothesis_result: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_ARCHITECTURE_LEVEL: admission controllers or higher-level tooling can mutate Pods, and Kata explicitly consumes per-Pod runtime annotations; the canonical contract already requires admission-time rejection.
non_overlap: No open PR was found implementing a Kata annotation ValidatingAdmissionPolicy. The lane adds new files and does not edit the StatefulSet/PVC hardening lane #630 or Kata advisory/version-floor lane #631.
go_unusual_experiment_reason: No shared immutable request/turn id is exposed and the available user-message timestamp is minute precision only; no unusual experiment was executed.
known_limits: The policy is a source candidate until applied to a real Kubernetes API server and exercised after mutation admission.
The Binding deliberately relies on a dedicated namespace label clayverse.seimensch.net/runtime=true; final deployment must prove that binding scope is present and effective.
This does not attest containerd/Kata runtime configuration or block runtime configuration introduced below Kubernetes admission.
The branch remained behind fast-moving main after the rebind; refresh/rejoin before promotion.
next_gate: Rejoin current main once at promotion time, run the exact branch tests in an authorized isolated full checkout, then apply the policy+binding to the admitted Kubernetes/Kata test cluster and prove malicious io.katacontainers.* Pod annotations are denied after mutation while clean ClayVerse Pods remain admitted; continue same-image-digest microVM, CNI, PVC, recovery and concurrency acceptance.
